title: Indo-Pacific Region: Conceptual Foundations
subject: Geography
description: A mindmap illustrating the three inter-related pillars that define the Indo-Pacific region: Geographic Continuum, Economic Interdependence, and Strategic Competition.

root((Indo-Pacific Region: Conceptual Foundations))
  Geographic Continuum
    From Eastern India to Western America
    Includes Indian Ocean, South China Sea
  Economic Interdependence
    US$5 Trillion+ global trade annually
    Malacca Strait: ~30% world maritime commerce
  Strategic Competition
    US vs. China rivalry
    Secondary actors: Japan, Australia, India
